title: Sign up
text: Register on our website so our team can contact you and guide you through the process.

title: Contact sales
text: Discuss car details, ask questions and confirm the vehicle you want.

title: Pay deposit
text: Send a deposit to secure your vehicle or start bidding.

title: Find & buy
text: Our experts help you find and purchase the best vehicle.

title: Pay full invoice
text: Complete the full payment to start the shipping process.

title: Shipping
text: Your vehicle will be shipped to your destination port.

title: Receive documents
text: All original documents are delivered to you via DHL.

title: Clear import
text: Clear your vehicle at the port and complete import procedures.

title: Share feedback
text: Share your experience with our service.

title: Enjoy your car
text: Enjoy your new car and return again for future purchases.
